constants._comment: Hardcoded in TokenFactory. Listed here for tooling, not configurable.
constants._launchSplit: Derived at deploy time from seeded USD value, not fixed. See LaunchPricing.
constants._seed_units: 8 decimals, matching the Chainlink ETH/USD feed — these are passed verbatim as PC_MIN_USDC_SEED_USD / PC_MIN_ETH_SEED_USD. They were previously written as plain dollars (2000 / 3000), which would have set the floors to $0.00002.
constants._seed_human: $2,000 USDC and $1,000 ETH. USDC is weighted heavier because it carries commerce, cross-merchant routing and cash-out.
constants._routerFeeBps_note: PC_ROUTER_FEE_BPS for DeployNetwork.s.sol. Basis points of the midpoint, skimmed by PunchCardRouter. Ceiling is MAX_FEE_RATE = 100 (1%), enforced in immutable code. Recorded here because the deploy script required it and no config file carried it — the figure lived only in README prose, so it would have been typed from memory at deploy time and then sat behind a 48-hour timelock.
